opportunities.name: Trip.com attractions search by city and keyword
opportunities.description: On Trip.com, search Attractions & Tickets for a given city and keyword, sort the results by a chosen order, and open an attraction.
steps: Type the city into the 'City or Region' box and pick it from the suggestions
Type a keyword into the keywords field
Pick a sort order (e.g. Top Rated or Lowest Price)
Open an attraction from the results and look at its details (e.g. Nearby)
